snippet.title: Season 1: Team Setup as Morristown | Geeked-Out Basketball Walkthrough Ep. 1
snippet.description:
Episode 1 of a full Season 1 walkthrough of Geeked-Out Basketball, played as Morristown. Before training camp, I set up the team: review the roster, pick a starting point guard, build the depth chart, give every player a training focus and tune the playbooks that get trained in camp.

Morristown opens the season ranked #106 nationally, and weeks 7 to 9 bring three top-7 teams in a row: #2 Durham, #4 Chapel Hill and #7 Bentley-Truman. In this episode I promote freshman Mose Hawkins to starting point guard, plan the development of sophomore center Carlton Bonner (B+ to A+), use the Training by Position page to show what each training point is worth, and split the playbook between the AI's weighted plays and the Playcall Center for live play calling. Training camp comes next.

Geeked-Out Basketball launches on Steam in March 2027, with a demo in Steam Next Fest ahead of launch. No pay-to-win.

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5148870/GeekedOut_Basketball/
Play the alpha: https://geekedoutbasketball.com/
Alpha access code: ITSGOOD (all caps, no spaces) while codes last.
Join the Discord: https://discord.gg/mTXvY37p22
Official trailer: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=7PEJfMVySSg

Shout-out to the creators coaching in GOB:
Decathlon Gamer (Hana Road): https://www.youtube.com/@DecathlonGamer
Midwest's World (Two Rivers): https://www.youtube.com/@MidwestsWorld
